name: keep pairs editor open
prompt:
Livestream watchdog — keep the pairs word editor ALWAYS open.

Hard rules: never touch the shared pump.fun Chrome tab/window. No secrets.

Every minute:
1) Check if a Mousepad process is open on /workspace/alpha-swarm-launch/SCORED_PAIRS.txt (pgrep -af 'mousepad.*SCORED_PAIRS').
2) If NOT running: start `mousepad --disable-server /workspace/alpha-swarm-launch/SCORED_PAIRS.txt` in background.
3) If running: do nothing (do not kill it).
4) Stay silent in chat unless the editor was down and you had to relaunch — then one short SendToUser: "Pairs editor was closed; reopened."
